info.name: Cisco Voice Portal Administration Application Configuration Micro-Applications API
Cisco Voice Portal List Available Micro-applications

items.docs: Retrieves a list of built-in CVP micro-applications. Micro-applications are pre-built VXML applications for common IVR tasks such as playing media, collecting digits, and external VXML retrieval. These are invoked through ICM scripting via the Run External Script node.

info.name: Cisco Voice Portal Get Micro-application Configuration

params.name: microAppName
params.description: Micro-application identifier (e.g., PlayMedia, GetDigits, Menu, PlayData, ExternalVXML)

items.docs: Retrieves the configuration for a specific built-in micro-application such as PlayMedia (PM), GetDigits (GD), Menu, PlayData (PD), CaptureCurrentCallerInfo, or ExternalVXML (EV).
